title: Sankranti
description: Sankranti holds immense significance for farmers, marking not just a change in seasons but also a culmination of their hard work and a promise of future prosperity. Sankranti is also called MakarSankranti. The name Makar Sankranti comes from the Sanskrit words Makara (Capricorn) and Sankranti (transition). The festival is also known as Uttarayan, which means going towards the north.
